name: Banana Peel Jeeter XL Infused Pre-Roll | 2g
description: Banana Peel hits with a unique mix of fruity, herbal sweetness wrapped in banana and grape tones. Each inhale leans sweet and smooth, while the exhale lingers with earthy depth. True to its name, this strain sneaks up on you with weighty, grounding vibes that feel like a full stop in the best way.
